_comment: Dual-title / eyebrow architecture for the landing feed cards. Per edition: 'eyebrow' = a clean operational category (rendered uppercase, accent) shown ABOVE the creative title; 'subtitle' = a concrete plain-English descriptor of what the brief is actually about, shown UNDER the title. Grounded in each edition's fact-checked content — no new claims. Injected into ai-radar/index.html by scripts/card_meta.py. Add an entry when a new edition ships, then re-run the script.
